title: When the Inheritance Falls
author: F. M. Voss
blurb: Tamsin Winterbourne, a night-shift dispatcher for a taxi company, thought they had seen every way a life can end. But when a client pays in advance to prove a murder hasn't happened — yet, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must find the witness everyone swears is dead before the anniversary dinner raises its glass.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
